summary: Retract the two Guns & Gears `source` overlay rows the table's own fold now makes redundant (desk #166, applied 2026-09-29).

backfillRows.why: feat-8528 (Firework Technician Dedication) is printed in 'Guns & Gears (Remastered)'; scripts/data/book-names.json folds that title into 'Pathfinder Guns & Gears' and the chain's same-book fold (foldBookSpellings, scripts/lib/aon-facets.mjs, run after each overlay pass) writes the key this row wrote by hand, so the row is redundant (desk #166).

the vial granted by feat-8528 (Firework Technician Dedication, 'Guns & Gears (Remastered)'): its create row spells the book 'Pathfinder Guns & Gears (Remastered)', which scripts/data/book-names.json folds into 'Pathfinder Guns & Gears' and the chain's same-book fold (foldBookSpellings, scripts/lib/aon-facets.mjs) writes after the create, so this `source` row is redundant (desk #166).
